page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: ornamental rule, then title, subtitle, scripture citation with verse, a rule, then SUMMARIUM heading and numbered list running to a catchword at lower right. Page number at top right corner (a small mark, illegible as a number).

l.i: Vir si voverit votum, aut si juraverit
suam, non polluet verbum suum, secundum omne
quod egressum est ex ore suo, faciet.

page.notes: The title line is set in roman and italic type; the list numbers are in roman. The top right mark is a small printed number or mark, not clearly legible. The ornamental rule and the horizontal rule are decorative. The catchword "Obliga-" appears at the foot right with the signature "A" at the left. Some text is damaged at the left and right margins by show-through and stains, which were not transcribed.
